Ankahee offers one-on-one therapy and counselling. Our sessions are planned in advance and are not designed to provide immediate support during a mental health crisis or emergency. 

If you are in immediate danger, feel that you may hurt yourself or someone else, or need urgent support, please contact your nearest hospital or emergency service, or reach out to a crisis helpline that can provide immediate assistance. You do not have to navigate a crisis alone. Reaching out for urgent support is a way of taking care of yourself, and you deserve to have someone with you when things feel overwhelming.

For crisis and emotional support, you can find verified helplines based on your needs through https://findahelpline.com/. The platform lists helplines offering phone, WhatsApp, text, and chat support across a range of concerns, including suicidal thoughts, emotional distress, domestic violence, grief, anxiety, and substance use.

If you are in immediate physical danger, please contact your nearest emergency service or hospital directly.

You care about each other, but somehow keep having the same argument. Or maybe you've stopped knowing how to reach each other.

Couples therapy is a space to slow down those patterns, understand what is happening between you, and work towards more honest communication, connection, and trust.

Whether you're navigating recurring conflict, emotional distance, trust issues, intimacy, or a major life transition, we work with both partners to understand the relationship rather than deciding who is right or wrong.
Couples or partners, at any stage of their relationship.
